svg.title: P17: Verify-on-stop guards collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A2 · guard role collaboration
The agent proposes completion after producing an
A stop or finish action is requested.
The stop is accepted only after the verifier
Stop can be intercepted and at least one
The same acceptance gate cannot be bypassed
explicit unknown or failure, not silent
1 propose(stop) → 2 request(verification) → 3 verify(artifact) → 4 inspect(claims) → 5 return(evidence) → 6 decide(verdict) → 7
Evidence: 8/41 repositories, 8/36 families; 8 trajectories (3 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: 0 supported, 1 unresolved, 0 rejected.
Variation: Project test commands, acceptance hooks, verifier agents, and blocking policies.
Negative control: Tests run by the user after the run are not verify-on-stop.
